decisions.reason: The Beneath (TFG's Nether) and illager raids don't apply here; forging steps and steel toughness from TFC's field guide.
desc:
Metal armor requires a two-step forging process, but don't be scared off by its difficulty: smith an unfinished piece from a &7double sheet&r (a single sheet for boots), then weld a sheet onto it (a double sheet for chestplates).

All metal armor will give you bonus protection to &6Slashing&r, &9Piercing&r, and &2Crushing&r damage, and steel armor adds toughness on top.

decisions.reason: #tfc:javelins is #c:tools/spear here; the Quiver (sns) isn't in this pack; added that skeletons are immune to piercing (TFC data).
desc:
If you want to keep your foes away from you, javelins are the weapon for you. They are the earliest ranged weapons you will have available to you. They deal &9Piercing&r damage, which can help you against Zombies, but Skeletons shrug it off completely.

For more information on &cDamage Types&r consult the &3Field Guide&r.

Here red steel (not blue) welds Create's copper diving gear into its netherite tier (Woodencog). Create grants lava immunity only when legs and feet are fire-resistant too, and netherite leggings are unreachable, so 'impervious to lava' is false; ambient-temperature protection is a TFG mechanic.
decisions.title: Red Steel Diving Gear
decisions.subtitle: Almost lava-proof
desc:
In this pack, &4Red Steel&r takes Create's diving gear to its netherite tier: weld a Red Steel Helmet, Chestplate or Boots onto the matching copper piece to get the &4Netherite Diving Helmet&r, &4Backtank&r and &4Boots&r. They're much tougher than copper, and with air in the backtank the helmet lets you breathe even in &clava&r.

Create only makes you immune to burning when &oall four&r armor slots are fire-resistant, and the leggings would have to be netherite, which needs the Nether. So treat lava as deadly all the same.
